Deeper-engagement lever teeth with release relief, a two-part carriage and separate stop pads. Both lozenges are on one printed member, now with 1.5 mm radii on the working corners. Current carriage: flush small member (0.8 mm lip removed), extended base lip; guides unchanged. Bridge band holder rebuilt on a centred tapered base; band alignment preserved. Deeper tooth revision and checks · Print revised lever only · Rounded contacts and durability checks · Four replacement parts · Printing and assembly notes

The full cycle follows a coupled rigid-contact calculation: input rotation is shared between reaction-gear rotation and worm/carriage travel. A resisting carriage load is assumed; the lever follows its current contact branch and the band returns it toward neutral when released. Red highlights indicate carriage motion under lever–lozenge restraint. Calculated release occurs at −3.91 / +3.71 mm, before the mechanical travel limits. This is a geometric motion model, not a prediction of force, friction, flexibility or reliable printed operation. Travel and lever sliders remain manual inspection controls.
